title: Session Prep, Run Sheet, GM Screen & Live Reference Workspace
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Session Prep, Run Sheet, GM Screen and Live Reference Workspace preparation over the MAS-01..15 foundations while preserving canonical Session, GM/live runtime, Visibility, Knowledge and Action/Event owner authority and keeping prepared session-reference tooling distinct from live session state or runtime mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared Session Prep, Run Sheet, GM Screen and Live Reference Workspace structures inside MAS without turning prepared reference tooling into canonical Session state, GM/runtime state, player visibility/knowledge state or live Action/Event truth.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically prepare session-reference structures over completed MAS foundations with explicit canonical owner references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving Session, GM/runtime, Visibility, Knowledge and Action/Event authority and never treating prepared session-reference tooling as proof of live session occurrence or mutation.

selection_boundaries: Owner Continue governed-started MAS-16 on 2026-09-16; only work/mas-16-session-prep-run-sheet-gm-screen-live-reference-workspace has product implementation authority.
MAS-01 through MAS-15 remain completed foundations and are not reopened silently.

Prepared Session Prep, Run Sheet, GM Screen and Live Reference Workspace structures remain preparation/reference semantics only; canonical Session and GM/live runtime owners retain live session state and mutation authority.
Visibility and Knowledge owners retain disclosure and knowledge authority; MAS-16 may bind explicit validated references but must not apply player visibility or knowledge mutation.
Action/Event and applicable runtime owner domains retain occurrence and event authority; prepared run-sheet/reference entries do not prove that an action, event, scene or session occurred.
MAS-16 must consume explicit MAS-15 prepared references plus validated Session, GM/live runtime, Visibility, Knowledge and Action/Event owner references and fail closed on unresolved references.
Existing MAS validation family remains active; no family transition is authorized in MAS-16.
MAS-17 retains Playtest, Branch Simulation, State Snapshot & Reset Workspace scope and must not be pulled forward.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-17+ and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
next_action: Load only MAS-15 plus targeted Session, GM/live runtime, Visibility, Knowledge and Action/Event owner seams; establish causal RED through the public MAS-16 seam before production implementation.
